no_echo_meaning: producer-confirmed absence of detectable return in valid observed region; not measured 0 dBZ or zero surface rain
unknown: NaN in scientific target; false in observation_mask; zero only as masked tensor placeholder
continuous_output: retain raw model scores; do not interpret scores between 0 and 20 as measured subthreshold reflectivity
categorical_output: nearest code in [0,20,25,30,35,40,45,50]; ties choose lower code; for derived display only
input_normalization: per-channel population mean/std over each eligible unique training hour and each grid point once, before overlapping patches
spatial_reference: inherit exact 14j geometry and checksums through 14n; no new georeferencing
radar_resampling: existing nearest native pixel; no averaging or max pooling
era5_resampling: bilinear interpolation on latitude/longitude; no extrapolation
coverage: inherit 14n observed_region_mask and its provisional or reviewed status
patch_edges: append final start at height-size and width-size; full geometric coverage without padding
patch_selection: all patches with at least one supported pixel; no echo-based oversampling
temporal_aggregation: none; exact UTC hour paired with local radar filename using historical America/Sao_Paulo offsets
map_policy: inherit hash-specific 14n reviews; pending maps remain excluded
native_loss: mean over supported pixels per batch; no NaN arithmetic; residual and noise zero outside support
